# MeedyaDL 1.11.0-alpha.20

A quiet release — the earliest behind-the-scenes plumbing for future Spotify support started landing, but there's nothing new to see or use yet.

### Notes

- Early groundwork for future Spotify support began landing this release, entirely behind the scenes. Nothing changes in how you use MeedyaDL today, and Spotify downloading isn't available yet.
- This is a pre-release on the **alpha** channel — early access to work in progress. The in-app updater serves the latest stable unless you've opted into Alpha.
